mu_name_from: MuMain maps MODEL_HELM + i to HelmMale{i+1}, so file 05 is armour index 4, which openmu names Bone. Not Plate - Plate is index 9, file 10.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateArmor(number, slot, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel). `armor.Group = (byte)(slot + 5)`, so slot 2 is group 7, 3 is 8 and 4 is 9.
stats.defense_note: Points of defence, in the row and summed into Player.ArmourDefense by Wear - see shared/Rows.cs.
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are 1, 0, 0 - the Dark Wizard alone.
stats.shelf_note: On Pasi's shelf at +2, the middle column of the mage's stock - see shared/Market.cs.

blocked_was: This asset carried a `blocked` note saying the pipeline handled one sheet per asset. That was true when it was written and is not now - ArmorMale10 wears upper_11 and hide, GloveMale06 wears gloves_07 and hide, and both are built - so the note is gone and the piece goes down the same path they did.
sheet_overrides_from: head_a06 is the Dark Wizard's hair, six triangles of it, and the bake welded them into the helm's own shell - one UV island, one material, so the hair was shipping as pitted bone. It was written up here as the island rule's limit and it is not one any more: a named sheet is lifted into an island of its own before the maps are built, so these six faces take hair and the other sixty-seven stay bone. See build_maps, where the lift is, and HelmMale10, whose plume needed no such thing because the unwrapper had already given it two islands.
material_note: Bone, and not the profile's plate_steel, which is what this set was built with and is the fault behind 'the bone set seemed dark'. MU paints these five sheets dark - upper_06 means 83 and lower_06 means 57 against the Plate set's 137 - and a dark albedo declared metallic 1.0 has no diffuse term to carry its mid-tones, so the armour kept the drawn highlights and went black between them. Nothing here was forged: it is skull, rib and claw over a dark hide. See materials/bone.json, which argues the number and the case against reusing chitin. Two islands. Island 0 is 73 triangles of the 112 and is the helmet: head_06's 60 plus the 6 of head_a06, the hair, and hide's 7 caps, which the bake welded into one island through shared verts. The hair no longer ships with the helmet's surface: see sheet_overrides_from, which lifts head_a06's six faces out of the island they share and gives them hair. Island 1 is the 39 triangles of skin_warrior_01, which is the face under the open front, and takes skin.
